title: 3283. Maximum Number of Moves to Kill All Pawns

examples.explanation: The knight takes 4 moves to reach the pawn at (0, 0).

Alice picks the pawn at (2, 2) and captures it in two moves: (0, 2) -> (1, 4) -> (2, 2). Bob picks the pawn at (3, 3) and captures it in two moves: (2, 2) -> (4, 1) -> (3, 3). Alice picks the pawn at (1, 1) and captures it in four moves: (3, 3) -> (4, 1) -> (2, 2) -> (0, 3) -> (1, 1).

Alice picks the pawn at (2, 4) and captures it in two moves: (0, 0) -> (1, 2) -> (2, 4). Note that the pawn at (1, 2) is not captured. Bob picks the pawn at (1, 2) and captures it in one move: (2, 4) -> (1, 2).
